description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter-based e-commerce application, incorporating various UI components such as banners, product lists, and sale sections, organized within a CustomScrollView with slivers.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the home screen, constructing a scrollable layout with promotional banners, product lists, and category sections.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, returning a Scaffold containing various slivers for app content.
